product_family: AI research assistant platform (scispace.com): literature search/review, Chat with PDF, AI Writer, citation tools, data extraction, and biomedical/agentic workflows, offered as a free/consumer tier, paid individual/team plans, and a separately marketed SciSpace for Enterprise tier for R&D teams in pharma, biotech, and healthcare.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Compliance: SOC 2 Type II — Compliant. Resources: PubGenius Inc. (Scispace) SOC 2 Type 2 2025 Report

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II (independent corroboration)
certifications.proof_quote: SciSpace is SOC 2 Type 2 certified. All uploaded documents are stored in isolated, encrypted environments (AWS S3 + RDS). Enterprise deployments include RBAC and SSO for identity management.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. The vendor's Delve-hosted trust center lists only one item under "Compliance" (SOC 2 Type II); ISO 27001 is not listed, and no separate ISO 27001 certificate or registrar record was found on any scispace.com or trust.scispace.com page.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a HIPAA compliance program or BAA offering. SciSpace markets a product feature called a "HIPAA Safe Harbor Checklist" AI agent, a document-analysis tool for researchers de-identifying data; this is a customer-facing feature, not a vendor HIPAA certification.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy table of contents includes a dedicated "European Union, United Kingdom, and Swiss Data Subject Rights" section, plus general Data Security and disclosure sections addressing personal-data handling.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not listed on the trust center; no PCI DSS claim found on any vendor page (billing is a typical SaaS subscription, likely handled by a third-party payment processor, but this was not independently confirmed).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI management system certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on any vendor-domain page.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; product is marketed to academic and commercial R&D, not to US federal agencies.

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor states consistently across multiple own-domain pages that customer-uploaded content is not used to train its AI models. Help Center: "We want to assure you that your uploaded PDFs are private and are not used for training our AI models. This policy applies equally to both Free and Paid users... SciSpace AI models are not trained on any uploaded PDFs." Enterprise FAQ: "No. SciSpace does not use customer data for LLM training. Enterprise LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry) operate under data-processing agreements that exclude customer data from model training." No public standalone Data Processing Agreement (DPA) document was found; likely available on request through enterprise sales but not independently confirmed.
privacy.data_region: Hosted on AWS (documents stored in "isolated, encrypted environments (AWS S3 + RDS)" per the Enterprise FAQ); specific AWS region(s) / data-residency options are not publicly disclosed on the pages reviewed.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Listed as an implemented control ("Cryptographic protections: Encryption in transit") on the SOC 2-backed trust center.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Listed as an implemented control ("Encryption at rest"); Enterprise FAQ confirms documents are stored in "isolated, encrypted environments (AWS S3 + RDS)."

security.name: Multi-factor authentication
security.value: Listed as an implemented control on the trust center.

security.name: SSO / SAML
security.value: Available for Enterprise deployments: "Setup SSO 2FA logins with your existing Authentication stack."

security.name: Role-based access control (RBAC)
security.value: "Enterprise deployments include RBAC and SSO for identity management."

security.name: Vulnerability / patch management
security.value: Listed as implemented controls ("Patch management", "Vulnerability scanning and remediation") on the trust center.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Listed as an implemented control under third-party management on the trust center.

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Listed controls include "Data retention and deletion policy" and "Customer data deletion."

products.name: SciSpace (Free / Individual)
products.data_scope: User-uploaded PDFs/papers, chat history; private to the user and not used for AI training per vendor Help Center statement.
products.notes: Core tools: Chat with PDF, Literature Review, AI Writer, Find Topics, Paraphraser, Citation Generator, Extract Data, AI Detector.

products.name: SciSpace Premium / Team plans
products.data_scope: Same data-handling posture as free tier per available evidence; no distinct compliance claims found beyond the platform-wide SOC 2 Type II.
products.notes: Pricing page references individual/premium plans; no team-specific security terms were located.

products.name: SciSpace for Enterprise
products.data_scope: Corporate/proprietary research documents; stored in isolated, encrypted AWS environments; processed via enterprise LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry) under agreements excluding customer data from model training.
products.notes: Adds SSO/SAML, RBAC, and is marketed to Pharmaceutical, Academia, Medical Devices, Consumer Goods, Advanced Manufacturing, and CRO customers. Sales-assisted ("Talk to Sales"), no self-service enterprise signup.

products.name: SciSpace Chrome Extension / Mobile App
products.data_scope: Same account/data model as the web product; no separate compliance claims found.
products.notes: Listed in site footer navigation; not independently reviewed for distinct data handling.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium consumer product with paid individual/premium plans, plus a separately sold, sales-assisted Enterprise tier for institutions and R&D teams.
compare.data_residency: AWS-hosted (S3 + RDS); specific region(s)/data-residency choices not publicly disclosed.

flags: Vendor markets a product feature named "HIPAA Safe Harbor Checklist" (an AI agent that helps researchers de-identify data); this is a customer-facing tool, not evidence of SciSpace/PubGenius holding HIPAA compliance certification.

The Delve-hosted trust center (trust.scispace.com) lists only SOC 2 Type II under "Compliance"; no ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or AI-governance certs are listed. This is typical for a growth-stage vendor.
No standalone public Data Processing Agreement (DPA) document was found; presumably available through enterprise sales but unconfirmed.
Specific data residency / region options are not publicly disclosed beyond generic "AWS" hosting.

Legal entity name appears as "Pubgenius, Inc." in the Terms of Use and "PubGenius Inc." elsewhere (capitalization only); both list the same Milpitas, CA address on the homepage footer and Terms of Use, indicating a single entity.
